description: Checklist-first map generation pipeline for Heavy Armor CSV maps. This file is the source-of-truth index and loading sequence. Detailed step instructions live in mapgen/rules/steps/ so each step can be edited independently.

room.description: A room is an intended enclosed usable space with a named size category or exact dimensions. Room size is measured by interior floor tile area only.

hallway.description: A hallway is a corridor floor region that connects rooms or other hallways. Hallways are placed before walls are derived, so they receive walls from the same single wall-layer process as rooms.

hardInvariants: Generate floors first. Do not generate walls room-by-room.
Create intermediate drafts before final CSV output.
Hallways are floor regions and must be placed before walls are derived.
Walls are derived once from the final union of all floor regions, including rooms and hallways.
No double walls anywhere. Do not solve exposed floors by adding a second wall layer.
Every visible exterior border of the final ragged shape must be wall, door, or window.
No floor tile may touch outside or missing space in the four cardinal directions.
Interior doors must connect floor to floor on opposite through-sides.
Exterior doors may connect floor to outside, but exterior doors do not count for room-to-room connectivity.
Doors may not be adjacent to other doors.
All rooms must be reachable from all other rooms through interior floors, hallways, and valid interior doors.

roomSizes.boundaryBehavior: If a boundary value appears in two bands, prefer the smaller named size unless the user explicitly asks otherwise.
